start.topic: Perimeter of rectangles, squares and polygons
start.opening: Namaste Kabir, main Asha, aapki AI teacher. Aaj hum perimeter seekhenge. Aapko rectangles, squares ya polygons mein kaunsa shape pasand hai?

turns.line: mujhe koi aur topic padhna hai
turns.reply: Kabir, woh topic aapki class ke lessons mein nahi hai. Aaj ka perimeter naye tareeke se karein, ya aaj ke liye rok dein—batayiye.
Theek hai Kabir, ek vegetable patch ke chaaron taraf fencing lagani ho, toh boundary ki sabhi sides ko jodna padega. Aap kya jodenge?

turns.line: mujhe koi aur topic padhna hai
turns.reply: Kabir, aap perimeter ko story, drawing, ya real-life example se padh sakte hain. Aap kis tareeke se continue karenge?
